'''Connect the World''' (Japanese: '''セカイツナガレ''' ''Sekai Tsunagare'') is the Japanese opening theme for the ''[[Wonder Voyage]]'' arc and the seventh of ''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]''. It will debut in [[HZ137]], replacing [[Iolite]].

The full version of the song will be released as a [[List of Pokémon digital singles#Connect the World|digital single]] on May 22, 2026.
